summary_en: Simplified share exchange completed 1 Jul 2026 making Olympic Group (Tokyo-based shopping center operator) 100% subsidiary of Pan Pacific International Holdings. Exchange contract signed 6 Apr 2026; Olympic Group shareholders approved 28 May 2026. Pan Pacific used simplified procedure without shareholder meeting; one dissenting shareholder.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Full Subsidiary Status of Olympic Group Corporation via Simplified Share Exchange
translation_en_brief: Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation notified on 1 July 2026 that a simplified share exchange with Olympic Group Corporation had become effective, resulting in Olympic Group becoming a 100% subsidiary. The share exchange contract was signed on 6 April 2026 and approved by the Pan Pacific board on the same date. Olympic Group's shareholders approved the transaction at its ordinary general meeting on 28 May 2026. Pan Pacific executed the exchange using the simplified procedure under Company Law Article 796(2), which did not require Pan Pacific shareholder approval. One Pan Pacific shareholder filed a dissenting notice, but the number of dissenting shares fell below the statutory threshold required for appraisal rights. Olympic Group, headquartered in Kokubunji, Tokyo, operates shopping centers and provides consolidated management services across the Olympic Group. Its capital is 9,946 million yen.
